verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's own Flights feature runs Python jobs automatically on a schedule, with scheduling, secrets, logging and versioning handled by the platform. That is time-based automation, though, not rules that fire on data or system events. No documentation shows event-driven triggers, conditional rules, alerts or webhooks, so this counts only as glancing support. Missing for 10: event-based triggers (e.g., on data change, on load, on threshold), a rule-definition mechanism, alerting or outbound actions on events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
